summary.intent: Execute all plans in Phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) using wave-based parallel execution across 8 plans in 4 waves, hardening the IPNS verification stack to be strictly fail-closed.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed successfully (plans 60-01, 60-02, 60-03 done, 3/8 plans), with the Rust verify chokepoint relocated/hardened, all 9 first-publish producers unified to seq=1, and the TS resolve path converted to strict fail-closed. Wave 2+ not shown in transcript.

repo: Phase 60 has 8 plans across 4 waves; Wave 4 (60-08) is non-autonomous — requires human operational cutover (staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test)
The codebase has no submodules, so all plans use worktree isolation per the GSD config
VerifyError::Legacy variant was removed in 60-01 (D-04 decision); all 9 FUSE caller arms were folded to use VerifyError::Invalid instead
Pre-existing dead-code warnings exist in the vendored `fuser` crate and on a test mock — these are not regressions
IPNS first-publish producers span 4 layers: FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, and web (9 total call sites)

code.finding: Old home of the verified-IPNS-resolve implementation; moved to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs in 60-01 so sdk/fuse/desktop share one impl
New canonical location for the strict fail-closed IPNS resolve chokepoint after 60-01
Was flagged as a remaining VerifyError::Legacy reference mid-execution, but grep confirmed it was already updated to use VerifyError::Invalid — the diagnostic was a stale mid-edit snapshot

workflow: Sequential gsd-executor subagents on the main working tree was chosen over worktree-isolated parallel agents because the harness can't reliably merge back worktree agent branches — correctness over wall-clock speed for a crypto-critical phase
A mid-execution compile-error diagnostic from a subagent can be a stale mid-edit snapshot; always verify with an authoritative `cargo check` before treating it as a blocker
The GSD execute-phase workflow checks for blocking antipatterns, orphaned worktrees, and partial work before dispatching any waves

friction: False compile error report from the 60-01 executor: it reported E0599 (no variant Legacy) even though it had already folded all 9 call sites — required manual grep + cargo check to confirm the tree was actually green
The Agent tool worktree isolation path is unsupported for merge-back in this harness, forcing a fallback to slower sequential execution on the main branch
open_items: Wave 2 (60-04, 60-05, 60-07): route all Rust consumers fail-closed, tighten API regime, regen cross-lang vectors
Wave 3 (60-06): API publish-path verify cache for CPU cost recovery
Wave 4 (60-08): D-01/D-12 operational cutover — non-autonomous, requires human to wipe staging + redeploy + run smoke tests
Windows WinFSP site validation for 60-02 seq=1 change is CI-gated only, not locally verifiable
